_doc: COMPILER POCKET spec — a 480x480 forest clearing/campsite pocket inside D10 Camping Forest's declared bbox (4200,200,1900,1400), NOT a replacement of the hand-authored district. Verified empty ground: no patch/stamp/solid/road of any existing d*.json (including d10's own hand stamps, which per EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4 actually live far outside D10's declared bbox) falls inside this pocket's rect. Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/wild.json -v --qa

compiler._doc: coords 'local': every rect/point below is relative to bbox, so the pocket relocates by editing bbox alone.

label: WILD CAMP

surfaces.name: clearing
surfaces._doc: forest-floor grass covers the WHOLE bbox so pass A never leaves a sliver of world grass at an edge

surfaces.name: pond_shore
surfaces._doc: a sandy shore shelf in the SE corner, overwriting grass, so the little camp pond reads as a proper beach-edge rather than water dropped straight into turf

surfaces.name: camp_pond
surfaces._doc: the bottom strip of the shore shelf, nested inside pond_shore, so shore_line derives a sand/water boundary in the SE corner for a fishing/pier flavour without touching the rest of the clearing

slots.name: camp
slots._doc: the main clearing: packed conifers/leafy trees per the wild biome's own density profile, camp clutter, spare furniture beyond the campfire_set/tent_cluster groups, and standalone tents (tent_blue_front/side are filed role=canopy in the enriched catalog, so canopy density is how extra loose tents get scattered here)

slots.name: trail
slots._doc: the dirt entrance track down from the world edge into the clearing; the gateway sign anchors here

slots.name: campfire_circle
slots._doc: open ground around the campfire_set group: a couple of spare chairs/tables plus cookware clutter

slots.name: pond_edge
slots._doc: the camp pond's wet-sand/water boundary: buoys, lily pads, a canoe. grp.camping.pier_walkway needs surface=water but the compiler marks every water cell UNWALKABLE|RESERVED in pass A, and pass D's place_group() rejects any group footprint touching a RESERVED cell (verified empirically: 0/1 placed, 14 anchors tried) -- a water-surface atomic group cannot land under the current pass D implementation, so the pier is represented here as scattered water_prop/decor_small instead of the grp recipe. See report notes.

landmarks._doc: hero camper trailer, west side of the clearing
second, smaller cabin/trailer, NE corner away from the pond and the trail
entrance arch sign at the foot of the dirt trail

groups._doc: fire + folding chairs + stumps + firewood, the heart of the clearing
two front+side tent pairs scattered through the clearing
fish crates + bucket + baited rod corner near the pond; surface=ground so it lands on the grass fringing the shore, not on the sand/water itself
clothesline + storage bin + rope coil dressing the pond-side camp

constraints._doc: 480x480 pocket is 30x30 = 900 cells; wild biome runs vegetation at 'packed' so budgets are looser than beach.json's 400x280/450-cell pocket
